# v0.26.1 — delegated-child compaction fix (#937)

Qualified at the release candidate tag `v0.26.1-rc1` (`c0a7b8f5`): this GA tree is that tree plus this file
(RELEASE-READINESS-V1; `git diff --name-status v0.26.1-rc1..v0.26.1` = only this file).

**GA acceptance:**
- **Gauntlet at the rc1 tag: PASS.**
  - Phase A: 15 tools; 30 matrix rows and 4 batteries, identical to `v0.26.0-rc1`'s receipt.
  - Phase B: six independent finders on two model families over `v0.26.0..v0.26.1-rc1` found 0 issues;
    upgrade → rollback → re-upgrade passed 6 of 6 steps on two stores; the delegated-child cells passed 12 of 12 on
    every pinned build at the tag.
  - Phase C: two cells, the pinned 0.21.5 host and the current managed fleet runtime. Each ran 44 turns with 0 timeouts,
    a restart and a re-paste. They committed 19 and 16 compactions with no loss and no conflict. The slowest
    compactions took 64.3 s and 71.9 s (bar: 145 s). No probe was LOST. #944 tracks one cell whose reader gave fewer
    exact answers than at `v0.26.0-rc1`; that is reader variance, and the other cell scored 3 of 3.
- **The fix holds on real host code: PASS** on all five pinned builds (the cells under Qualification).
- **Defects:** no respin-bar defect that managed profiles can reach is open.
- **Recall scorecard, fast tier (#898): PASS.** 0 per-question `lcm_recall` flips and 0 full-text flips against `v0.26.0`
  over 500 questions; recall@10 is 0.8473, unchanged; A/A′ has 0 discordant rows.

This patch rides a minor that already passed its 24-hour reference-agent window. That window is a per-minor gate, so
none runs for this patch.

Patch release on top of `v0.26.0` (`867eb587`), cut from `release/v0.26.x`. Theme: a delegated child compacts like
its parent.
- **Before:** a `delegate_task` subagent whose engine is a fresh copy of the parent's never learned the host's model
  or context window. Its compaction threshold stayed 0, so it never compacted proactively and grew until the provider
  rejected the request. The host-fallback compressor then sent the model name `"unknown"`, which a provider can
  refuse.
- **After:** the child's engine takes the model and window the host resolves for it, and the host-fallback path never
  sends `"unknown"`.
- No tool name or count changed (15 tools); `LCM plugin loaded` and every `lcm_*` name are unchanged.
- No new setting, no prompt change, no schema change (schema 5) and no new table.
- This release never moves a deployed pin by itself. A deployment moves only when its operator re-pins it.

## Changes since v0.26.0

- **#937 (#938): a delegated child keeps the host's model and window.**
  - A fresh, unbound engine (the host gives each agent its own clone) accepts the host's model update, including
    updates during the run, so the child's threshold is real. An engine already bound to the foreground session still
    ignores a child's model update, as before, so a shared engine cannot move the parent's threshold.
  - **Host fallback.** Building the host's compressor and syncing its model use the active model or the configured
    summary model. If neither is known, LCM-X skips the host compressor, logs
    `reason=host_fallback_unresolved_model` once per engine, and uses the existing deterministic tail fallback. The
    string `"unknown"` no longer reaches a provider.
  - The host's post-compression check (the third symptom in #937) compares the rebuilt request against the child's
    threshold, which was 0. The threshold now carries the real value (the real-host cells below show it). The check
    itself lives in the host and is unchanged.
- **Tests (#938):** regression tests for the clone, the unbound child, a mid-run model update, the bound-engine guard
  and both fallback routes. The child and fallback tests were red on `v0.26.0`'s code before the fix; the
  bound-engine guard test passed before and after. A further test clones a parent already bound to a foreground
  session (both clone paths) and checks that the child's update lands and the parent is unchanged; it fails if a clone
  keeps the parent's session binding. Thirteen existing tests of the host compressor now supply a known model; their
  assertions are unchanged.
- **Docs:** the v0.26.0 GA status pages (#940) are carried onto this branch, plus this patch's identity.

## Qualification

- **Cross-model review.** #938 was written by Codex from a spec and reviewed by Claude against named risk probes
  (engine cloning and deep copy, every writer of the session binding, every host model-update site, test isolation).
  The one merge-blocking finding, an existing test the change had made vacuous, was fixed before merge.
- **Real host code, base against fix.** A child built by each host's own `delegate_task` builder, with a static
  1,050,000-token model window and no model call:
  - `v0.26.0`: child model empty, window 0, threshold 0, so the child never compacts;
  - the fix: child model set, window 1,050,000, threshold 367,500; `should_compress` is true at the threshold and false
    one token below;
  - the parent's model and threshold are unchanged in every cell.

  Hosts: all five builds the release pin lists (a 0.21.2 host, upstream 0.21.5, and the older, previous and current
  managed fleet runtimes), plus an upstream host that stamps message uids. Each ran at the `v0.26.1-rc1` tag against
  `v0.26.0`: 12 of 12 cells as above (`PHASE-B-RECEIPT.md`).
- **Full suite** at this tree, run the CI way: 6,214 passed, 92 skipped, 16 xfailed, 0 failed.
- **Gauntlet at the `v0.26.1-rc1` tag** (receipts are attached to this release):
  - [`PHASE-A-RECEIPT.md`](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/download/v0.26.1/PHASE-A-RECEIPT.md): the all-tools matrix on a fresh clone across privacy postures, plus
    the planted-secret, opt-out, durable-redaction and misconfiguration batteries. All pass, identical to
    `v0.26.0-rc1`.
  - [`PHASE-B-RECEIPT.md`](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/download/v0.26.1/PHASE-B-RECEIPT.md): the release manager's Phase B verdict over its two lanes,
    with the delegated-child cells on every pinned build at the tag. Its lanes:
    - [`PHASE-B-DISPOSITION.md`](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/download/v0.26.1/PHASE-B-DISPOSITION.md): six finders on two model families (codex:
      correctness, API contract, concurrency, security and privacy; Claude: performance and DoS, upgrade and

    - [`PHASE-B-HANDSON-RECEIPT.md`](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/download/v0.26.1/PHASE-B-HANDSON-RECEIPT.md): `v0.26.1-rc1` upgrade, `v0.26.0` rollback
      and `v0.26.1-rc1` re-upgrade on copies of two soak stores that `v0.26.0` wrote, one with host-uid bindings.

## Known follow-ups

- **A host that shares one engine between parent and child** is not among the tested hosts (each gives the child its
  own clone). On such a host the bound-engine guard keeps the parent's threshold; that branch is covered by a unit test
  only.
- **#944:** make the Phase C probe battery robust to a reader that rejects planted decisions as injected claims.
- v0.26.0's follow-ups are unchanged: #844, #534, #588, #7, #885, #881, #887, and slice C (`on` mode) of host message
  identity.

## Benchmark boundary

- No retrieval or QA benchmark claim. The change is confined to how a delegated child's engine learns its model and
  window and to the host-fallback route.
- The recall scorecard's fast tier (#898: embeddings off, every rc) ran at the rc1 tag against `v0.26.0`, question by
  question: 0 `lcm_recall` flips and 0 full-text flips over 500 questions (470 scored, 30 abstention questions
  excluded). Recall@10 is 0.8473 for `lcm_recall` and 0.8416 for full text, both unchanged. The embeddings-on rows
  are per-minor and do not run for this patch.

## Upgrade

- **Install:** plugin only. Verify the exact commit, install this tag at it and restart the gateway. No migration.
- **Rollback:** to `v0.26.0`, plugin only. The store is unchanged (schema 5).
- **Settings:** none.
